summary: Add a get_jobs_for(func) lookup to the schedule library so callers can find and cancel jobs by the function they run, without holding on to Job objects.
narrative: The owner asked for a way to look up jobs by the function they run, something like get_jobs_for(func), with tests, because they keep holding on to Job objects only to cancel them later. So far memory shows only exploration: one observation (#1) found that the schedule library stores scheduled callables as functools.partial on Job.job_func, which affects how a function match must be done. No implementation, tests, PR or release is recorded yet.
